title: One to two craft brought down per year at black sites
summary: UAPGerb tells of One to two craft brought down per year at black sites, about unspecified at black sites, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's also claims by Greer and others that at some of these black sites, um, one to two craft are brought down a year.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that Steven Greer, a well-known UFO activist, and others claim that one to two unknown craft are brought down each year at certain black sites, meaning secret military facilities that do not officially exist. If true, it would mean the government is regularly capturing non-human vehicles.
